zh: rng.u() 给 0 到 1 之间的均匀数；rng.normal() 标准正态；rng.uniform(a, b)；rng.exp(rate)；rng.t(nu)；rng.gamma(k)；rng.poisson(lam)；rng.bernoulli(q) 给 0 或 1；rng.int(n) 给 0 到 n−1 的整数
en: rng.u() gives a uniform number between 0 and 1; rng.normal() a standard normal; rng.uniform(a, b); rng.exp(rate); rng.t(nu); rng.gamma(k); rng.poisson(lam); rng.bernoulli(q) gives 0 or 1; rng.int(n) gives an integer from 0 to n−1

zh: function simulate(T, rng, p, K)   必须有。每条路径调用一次，返回 T+1 个数：每个都是有限的正的价格，第 0 个是起始价（一般取 100）。
en: function simulate(T, rng, p, K)   Required. Called once per path; returns T+1 numbers, each a finite positive price; the 0th is the starting price (usually 100).
T          Number of steps in a path

zh: K          每年几步。按年给的量要自己换算到每一步：一步的时间是 1/K
en: K          Steps per year. Quantities given per year must be converted to one step yourself: one step lasts 1/K

zh: p          参数，就是你在"参数"一栏里写的那些（p.sigma 这样用）
en: p          The parameters, i.e. what you wrote in the "Parameters" field (used as p.sigma)

zh: rng        这条路径专用的随机数，每条路径互相独立、可以复现。不要用 Math.random
en: rng        The random numbers reserved for this path; paths are independent of one another and reproducible. Do not use Math.random

zh: function deal(T, rng, p)      必须有。发牌：每一局开始时调用一次，返回这一局藏起来的东西 G（一个对象）。规则看不到 G。
en: function deal(T, rng, p)      Required. Deal: called once at the start of each episode; returns what is hidden in this episode, G (an object). Rules cannot see G.

zh: function show(G, t)           可以没有。亮牌：每回合开始时调用，返回规则这一回合能看到的东西：一个数、一个数组，或者只有一层的对象。
en: function show(G, t)           Optional. Show: called at the start of each round; returns what the rule may see this round: a number, an array, or an object with a single level.

zh: function referee(G, t, a)     必须有。判分：规则报出动作 a 之后调用，返回这一回合的得分（一个有限的数）。
en: function referee(G, t, a)     Required. Score: called after the rule has returned its action a; returns this round's score (a finite number).

zh: 规则报的不是数时 a 是 NaN。可以在 G 上记账；把 G.over 设成 true，这一局到此为止。
en: If the rule did not return a number, a is NaN. You may keep accounts on G; set G.over to true and the episode ends there.

zh: T          一局最多几回合；t 是第几回合，从 0 起
en: T          Maximum number of rounds in an episode; t is the index of the round, from 0

zh: p          玩法的参数，就是你在"参数"一栏里写的那些（只读）
en: p          The game's parameters, i.e. what you wrote in the "Parameters" field (read-only)

zh: rng        这一局专用的随机数。§0§。后面的回合还要用，就把 rng 存进 G
en: rng        The random numbers reserved for this episode. §0§. If later rounds need it too, store rng in G

zh: 一局的得分 = 各回合得分加起来。每条规则各打同样的几局，第 k 局发给每条规则的是同一副牌。
en: The score of an episode = the sum of the scores of its rounds. Every rule plays the same episodes; in episode k every rule is dealt the same hand.

zh: function decide(s, p, st)   必须有。每个回合调用一次，返回一个数：这一回合的动作。哪个数代表什么，看这套玩法的说明。
en: function decide(s, p, st)   Required. Called once per round; returns a number: this round's action. What each number means is explained in the game's description.

zh: function init(p)            可以没有。每一局开始时调用一次，返回的对象就是 decide 的第三个参数 st。
en: function init(p)            Optional. Called once at the start of each episode; the object it returns is decide's third argument st.

zh: s.see      这一回合裁判亮给你看的东西
en: s.see      What the referee shows you this round

zh: s.t  s.T   这是第几回合（从 0 起）、一局最多几回合

zh: s.last     上一回合的得分（第一回合是 NaN）
en: s.last     The previous round's score (NaN in the first round)

zh: s.total    这一局到目前为止的得分
en: s.total    The score of this episode so far
s.g        The game's parameters (read-only)
